comparison: Both policies receive identical predicted report meanings within each reader. Only grouping and unresolved-scope handling change. Metadata never enters the interpreter.
response_reuse: One response per distinct normalized report text and reader, joined to all occurrences, including both packets in each pair. Packet/report occurrences are correlated; they are not independent model calls.

narrow.input_scope: Observation detail only; asset identities normalized. No impact, paths, timestamps, policy text or packet target decisions.

broad.input_scope: Observation detail only; asset identities normalized. No impact, paths, timestamps, policy text or packet target decisions.
